lines.zh: 我滚过末地石，留下一道黏痕。
lines.en: I roll over end stone, leaving a gel trail.
Bounce by bounce, I move to the gate.
My body is heavy; slow but not spilling.

lines.zh: 这条走廊我守了很多年。
lines.en: I have guarded this corridor many years.
Purple light sways on the wall.

lines.zh: 我碾过一只末影螨，没停。
lines.en: I roll over an endermite without stopping.
The tower is tall; I hop step by step.

lines.zh: 凝胶拖在地上，像条尾巴。
lines.en: The gel drags behind like a tail.
I need no legs; rolling works.
At the city's edge I pause.

lines.zh: 虚空在下面，我贴着墙走。
lines.en: The void is below; I hug the wall.
I know every brick.
One step, two steps, three burns.
I guard this End city; stay back.
I know these parts well.
My gel drags on the floor as I shuffle.

lines.zh: 末地城是我守着的地方。
lines.en: The End city is what I guard.

lines.zh: 谁把末地城的路修这么长。
lines.en: Who made these End city halls so long?
Hurry up. The the Nether waits for no one.

lines.zh: 末地城的台阶，一步一黏。
lines.en: End city steps — each stride sticks.

lines.zh: 末地城里，我替它们看门。
lines.en: In the End city, I keep their door.

lines.zh: 跳过末地石之间的空隙。
lines.en: Hopping over the gaps in the end stone.

lines.zh: 滚过走廊，撞翻你的火把。
lines.en: Rolling down the hall, knocking your torch.

lines.zh: 一跳一停，找落脚的石块。
lines.en: Hop and pause, seeking a stone to land on.

lines.zh: 我身体里映着你的影子。
lines.en: Your shape reflects inside my body.
The gel turns slowly, like water.

lines.zh: 我在等下一个带装备的人。
lines.en: I wait for the next one carrying gear.

lines.zh: 这城里除了风，没别的声音。
lines.en: Nothing here but wind.

lines.zh: 我刚才吞了块碎砖，没味道。
lines.en: I swallowed a brick shard; no taste.

lines.zh: 守了这么久，铠甲早旧了。
lines.en: Guarding so long, my armor is worn.

lines.zh: 我试着记住每件兵器的样子。
lines.en: I try to remember every weapon's shape.

lines.zh: 末影人从塔上跳下去，我没跟。
lines.en: An enderman leaps down; I do not follow.

lines.zh: 我的形状是方的，改不了。
lines.en: I am square; I cannot change it.

lines.zh: 身上的凝胶又厚了一层。
lines.en: Another layer of gel on me.

lines.zh: 有人来过，砖上还有脚印。
lines.en: Someone came; footprints remain.
I count the chests in the city.
I watch the gates of the End city.
Can't recall what I was doing.
No fire in the End, only violet light.
No sun in this sky.
This place is truly boring.
Eyelids heavy. The fire's warm.

lines.zh: 塔里的风声像有人在哭。
lines.en: The wind in the tower sounds like crying.
Mimicream sets harder than jelly.
Flat against the wall, like a brick.
Should I roar? Maybe.

lines.zh: 你腰上那把剑，我看清了。
lines.en: I have seen the sword at your hip.
Your shield has a peculiar pattern.
I have memorized what you wear.

lines.zh: 你背上的弩，装填好了吗？
lines.en: Is the crossbow on your back loaded?

lines.zh: 三叉戟？我很久没见过了。
lines.en: A trident? I have not seen one in ages.

lines.zh: 你站得笔直，像个来挑战的。
lines.en: You stand straight, like a challenger.

lines.zh: 别以为我看不见你的弓。
lines.en: Do not think I miss your bow.

lines.zh: 你手里的食物，也能复制吗？
lines.en: Can I copy the food in your hand?
I am sizing you up, head to toe.
Your armor has a gap on the right.
Your eyes wander; planning to flank?

lines.zh: 我看你指节，那里会先动。
lines.en: I watch your knuckles; they move first.
You stepped back; noted.
You carry end dust on you.
Your hand slips on your sword hilt.

lines.zh: 你的脸映在我的胶体里。
lines.en: Your face reflects in my gel.
How long since anyone came to this tower?
I guard the End city gate.
Your hide is so thin.

lines.zh: 这团胶，能学你身上的东西。
lines.en: This gel can copy what you carry.
Another lost one.
Your sword? I'll make one just like it.
Don't let your eyes wander.

lines.zh: 末地城的灰尘沾在你衣上。
lines.en: End city dust clings to your clothes.
The sword cuts in; gel splashes out.

lines.zh: 我的身体凹了一块，会补上。
lines.en: A chunk of me is dented; it will fill.

lines.zh: 你砍出的角度，我学去了。
lines.en: I have learned the angle of your swing.
Even a square body fears blunt force.
The piece you cut off still twitches.
A corner of me chipped.
It hurts, but the gel regrows.
You missed and only grazed my edge.

lines.zh: 这一击，让我想学你的家伙。
lines.en: That blow makes me want your weapon.
I sink and hide the wound.
A chunk of my gel got cut away.

lines.zh: 胶体凹进去一块，弹回来。
lines.en: My gel dents inward, then springs back.
Hurts enough to smoke.
This? Nothing.
I'm knocked into two halves.
Purple gel splashes across the floor.

lines.zh: 末地城的风，从我身上刮过。
lines.en: The wind of the End city passes through me.
My gel wobbles. I can still fight.
That's going in the ledger.

lines.zh: 末地城守卫也会被偷袭。
lines.en: Even an End City guard can be ambushed.

lines.zh: 把那把剑举高点，让我看清。
lines.en: Raise that sword; let me see it clearly.
Lend me your shield's shape.
I do not eat; I only want to touch.
That glittering enchantment dazzles.
Change your gear before you come.
This blade's edge is slightly rolled.
I want to try that trident.
Your crossbow's click sounds lovely.

lines.zh: 把那盾翻个面，我还没看清。
lines.en: Turn that shield over; I have not seen it all.
Fine gear should stay in the city.
Hand over that gel.
A sweet smell leaks from the chest seam.
Don't go. Come closer.

lines.zh: 我这块凝胶，能把那点光吸干。
lines.en: This gel of mine would drain that glow dry.

lines.zh: 用我的凝胶换你的果子。
lines.en: I'll trade my gel for your fruit.
That scent pulls at me.
I'll trade for it. Honestly.
The jelly in your hand glows.
I guard the chests of the End city.
My flames is glowing.
You bump me; I wobble.

lines.zh: 我的凝胶黏住你的靴子了。
lines.en: My gel sticks to your boots.
Do not push; I fill the corridor.

lines.zh: 你滑出去老远，我的凝胶没晃。
lines.en: You skid far away; my gel does not quiver.
A square body hits hardest at the corners.

lines.zh: 你踩进我的身体里了，拔出来。
lines.en: You stepped into me; pull out.

lines.zh: 这一下，我的边凹了进去。
lines.en: That dented my edge.

lines.zh: 两块硬东西碰在一起，很沉。
lines.en: Two hard things meet with a heavy sound.
Stand back; I am turning.
Sticky things are hard to push.
You scatter half my gel.
Don't press up so close.
My temper is rising.
End cities are cramped — I sidle.
I guard the End City gate.
Bump me again. Try it.
You knocked me against the wall.
Burned you, didn't I? Serves you right.
One bump. One mark against you.
Steady. Don't fall on me.
We do not pair; we split.

lines.zh: 切一半下来，就是新的我。
lines.en: Cut half off, and that is a new me.

lines.zh: 凝胶够多，就自己长一个伴。
lines.en: With enough gel, I grow a companion.

lines.zh: 没有谁追谁，我们一样方。
lines.en: No one courts; we are equally square.
The piece I dropped still moves.

lines.zh: 两个我滚在一起，分不清。
lines.en: Two of me roll together, indistinguishable.
Splitting is tiring; I eat stone to recover.
We once shared one body.

lines.zh: 你分不出哪个是原来的。
lines.en: You cannot tell which was the original.
This small piece will guard for me.
I can keep you safe.
I already fed the fire.
Two gels slowly draw together.
Just give me a look.

lines.zh: 我这一身胶，闻起来像紫颂。
lines.en: My gel smells of chorus fruit.
Burn together. How about it?
My color turns pale violet.
Your fire burns brighter than mine.
Your horns look fine.

lines.zh: 末地城的门，我守了很多年。
lines.en: I've guarded the End City gates for years.
I will take this end stone.
The arrow you dropped is mine.
I wrap it inside my body.
Gel can hold quite a lot.
I will hold this chorus fruit.
Whoever threw this scrap iron, I take it.
I can swallow heavy things.
It dissolves slowly inside me.
I sink the sword deep in my gel.
What I pick up belongs to the city.
I guard the End City gate.
The gel of the end city is mine.
I guard the End City door.

lines.zh: 末地石掉下来，我收进身里。
lines.en: End stone drops, I take it into my body.
This could trade for gold.
Quick hands, huh?
Lucky me, I suppose.
End stone shards, all mine.
I like this color.
I stuff the chest into my body.
You crossed the gate; halt.
That sword will be mine shortly.

lines.zh: 守卫末地城是我的差事。
lines.en: Guarding this city is my duty.

lines.zh: 打我一下，你就知道后果。
lines.en: Hit me once and learn the cost.
I study your armor for a gap.
Another one after the chests.
Your steps are too heavy to hide.

lines.zh: 我要把你拦在这条走廊。
lines.en: I will stop you in this corridor.
Draw that blade and I will copy it.

lines.zh: 这层楼的砖，记得你的重量。
lines.en: This floor remembers your weight.
Not up the tower; that is mine.

lines.zh: 你身上的好东西太多了。
lines.en: You carry too many fine things.

lines.zh: 复刻凝胶在我体内转了一圈。
lines.en: Mimicream churned once inside me.
I posed as a block and waited.

lines.zh: 魔法在我体内转起来了。
lines.en: Magic spins up inside me.
My mimicream glows; let us begin.
In the End city, I guard the gel.
The tower top is small, where will you go?
You move too slowly; I moved first.

lines.zh: 你走进了末地城的门洞。
lines.en: You walked into the end city gateway.

lines.zh: 末地城的门，我守了太久。
lines.en: I've guarded this End city too long.
Now it's your turn to run.
A thread of magic wraps your ankle.
I see you, you.

lines.zh: 你身上的热气飘过来了。
lines.en: Your body heat drifts over.
The End city is mine to guard.
I roll at your heels; you cannot shake me.
You turn; I follow even into walls.
I follow your boot prints.
End stone is slick; I slow down.

lines.zh: 你躲到柱子后，我看见影子。
lines.en: You hide behind a pillar; I see the shadow.

lines.zh: 我的身体擦着地，声音很响。
lines.en: My body scrapes loudly on the floor.

lines.zh: 你跑不快的，这城没出口。
lines.en: You cannot run; this city has no exit.
I block half the corridor.

lines.zh: 你喘气的声音，在走廊里很响。
lines.en: Your breathing echoes loudly down this corridor.
Waiting for me to stop? I will not.
I have guarded every doorway.
You climb; the stairs are narrow.
I wait below for you to come down.
You're panting so loud.
This corridor holds only you and me.

lines.zh: 末地城的每一扇门，我都认得。
lines.en: I know every door in this End City.

lines.zh: 末地城边，我的胶质先抖。
lines.en: By the End city, my gel quivers.
I wait for you at the tower top.
I've copied your every move.

lines.zh: 一跳一跳地逼近楼梯口。
lines.en: Hopping closer to the stairway.
One bounce carries me two floors.
I don't need to hurry.
Stuck in shadow, watching you walk.

lines.zh: 凝胶一裂，我会再站起来。
lines.en: Crack my gel and I rise again.
Don't turn. It won't help.
Half the stairs are gone, jump.
No lava in the End, only me.
I ram your armor head-on.
Gel wraps your wrist.

lines.zh: 这一下，撞得你退了半步。
lines.en: That knockback pushed you half a step.

lines.zh: 我照着你的剑，回你一记。
lines.en: Copying your sword, I strike back.
My square corner jabs your ribs.

lines.zh: 你的盾挡得住，再来一下。
lines.en: Your shield holds; here is another.
I drop my weight and press down.
Stuck to your feet, you cannot move.
You swing wide; I roll to your flank.
I copy your bow and loose an arrow.

lines.zh: 这一下，用的是你的招式。
lines.en: That blow used your own move.
After long fighting, my gel thins.
Hear that whistle?
Magic crackles on my fist.

lines.zh: 我的魔法比我的身体重。
lines.en: My magic weighs more than my body.

lines.zh: 这点力气，我连凝胶都没抖。
lines.en: That was so weak my gel did not even quiver.
Let the fire speak.
My gel slaps your pauldron.

lines.zh: 这层凝胶会复制你的招。
lines.en: This gel copies your every move.
One blow and your shield cracks.
Move. It's coming down.
Violet light follows my fist.
Purple tendrils rise from the floor.

lines.zh: 胶体拳头砸向你的胸口。
lines.en: A gel fist slams your chest.

lines.zh: 末地城那级台阶，归我守。
lines.en: That End city step is mine to guard.
This one you'll remember.
I seep out of a brick seam.
My first meal was end stone.

lines.zh: 我还小，只有半个箱子大。
lines.en: I am small, half a chest in size.
The city was empty; I moved in.

lines.zh: 我的颜色是从墙上学来的。
lines.en: I learned my color from the walls.

lines.zh: 有脚步声，我赶紧躲进暗处。
lines.en: Footsteps; I hide in the dark.
The tower wind chills me.

lines.zh: 我试着弹了一下，摔散了。
lines.en: I tried to bounce and fell apart.
Slowly I gather myself back.
This corridor is mine now.
I have not learned to copy yet.
A pair of eyes watches from the dark.
First I pretend to be a brick.
Who's standing there?
This end stone is mine to guard.
Let me look around first.

lines.zh: 末地城里，我又闻到新东西。
lines.en: In the End city, I smell something new again.

lines.zh: 末地城里，我守着那道拱门。
lines.en: In the End city I guard that arch.

lines.zh: 末地的紫光刺得我发亮。
lines.en: The End's violet light makes me glow.
Fire's still lit. So am I.
Where am I? The Nether?
I crawl out of the chest.

lines.zh: 末地城里没有岩浆，我不习惯。
lines.en: There is no lava in the End city; I am not used to it.
The end city blocks reassemble.
Just formed, my gel is still soft.
Fire melts my corners.
Hot. But I don't fear it.

lines.zh: 从塔上摔下来，散成几块。
lines.en: Falling from the tower, I scatter in pieces.
My bones rattled on impact.
Water does not scare me; I just get heavy.
Choked on it. Awful.
The blast splatters me across the wall.
That shockwave had force.

lines.zh: 箭插在我身上，慢慢沉进去。
lines.en: The arrow sinks slowly into me.

lines.zh: 箭？背后有人，凝胶顶得住。
lines.en: Arrows? Someone behind me, my gel holds.

lines.zh: 魔法把我的形状搅乱了。
lines.en: Magic churns my shape.

lines.zh: 你的咒语被我吞下去了。
lines.en: I swallow your spell.

lines.zh: 太久没吃石头，身体变薄。
lines.en: Too long without stone; I thin out.
Need to find food.
Lightning strikes; my whole body glows.
Thunder? Here?
The void stretches me thin, almost breaking.
I'm falling...
